meta.title: AutoCircuit automation playbook
meta.purpose: Everything a new conversation or agent needs to drive Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre on UCSD ieng6 for this repo without rediscovering it: how to reach the server, how to run jobs, how results come back, and the traps already hit.
meta.repo: https://github.com/TimmyXu015/AutoCircuit (public -- never commit keys, IBM PDK model contents, or homework answers)

user_and_policies.who: UCSD student, ECE 203 (Fall 2026). Writes in Chinese; reply in Chinese. Self-described weak software and device-physics fundamentals: explain, do not just dump.
user_and_policies.homework_rule: The user does the homework reasoning. Build tooling, run simulations, return data + plots, point to where/how to read a quantity; do NOT hand over final homework answers unless the user explicitly delegates that part (e.g. they delegated tedious PDK-file grepping for P1e/P1g Vt).

results_folder.path: C:\Users\<win_user>\AutoCircuit_Results\<YYYY-MM-DD>_<job>_<short_desc>\  (on the user's Windows PC; win_user is Timmy)
results_folder.rule: Put every chart/CSV/script for the user there, one subfolder per experiment. NEVER delete anything in it -- the user deletes themselves.

user_and_policies.server_processes: The user often has their own GUI Virtuoso running on the same ieng6 host (it holds .cdslck locks and spectre sessions). Never kill the user's processes without asking.
user_and_policies.style: Deliver results, not narration. Final reply: what came out, the file, one next step.

access_paths.summary: The cloud container (Bash tool) cannot reach ieng6. The device_bash Linux VM on the user's PC has proxy-only network (no ssh). The working path is the MATLAB MCP server on the user's Windows PC: mcp__remote-devices__MATLAB__evaluate_matlab_code running system('ssh ...') with Windows OpenSSH.

ssh.user_host: lix015@ieng6-ece-10.ucsd.edu  (ieng6-ece-20.ucsd.edu also in known_hosts; plain ieng6.ucsd.edu FAILS with 'Host key verification failed' under BatchMode)
ssh.key: C:\Users\Timmy\.ssh\id_ed25519 (passwordless). Public key line in ieng6 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys, comment autocircuit-DESKTOP-IECEG8R -- removing that line revokes access.
quoting_rules: system() goes through cmd.exe: the remote command sits inside one pair of double quotes; inside it use NO further double quotes and avoid pipes combined with escaped quotes (\" breaks, '%' gets expanded).
Use pgrep -a -f, head, tail instead of 'ps | grep "..."'.

Anything non-trivial: write a script file into the results folder (device_bash heredoc), scp it up, then ssh 'bash script.sh'. Strip CR (char(13)) from files written on Windows before running them on Linux.
ssh.environment: Non-interactive ssh has no module environment: wrap Cadence commands in bash -lc '...' (single quotes doubled inside a MATLAB string: ''...''). run.sh also loads the course module itself if MODULESHOME is set.
ssh.long_jobs: Bridge calls time out at ~60 s and the device connection drops now and then. Start jobs detached and poll: ssh host "cd <workdir> && nohup bash -lc '~/AutoCircuit/run.sh <job>' > ~/AutoCircuit_results/<job>_run.out 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo started"; then tail that file in later calls. Never put pause() + ssh in one call longer than ~45 s.
ssh.file_transfer: scp one remote file per call: scp -o BatchMode=yes -q lix015@ieng6-ece-10.ucsd.edu:<remote_path> "C:\...\folder". Several remote paths in one quoted argument failed ('No such file').
ssh.after_disconnect: If the device disconnects mid-call, the remote job may still have run: check its output file before re-running anything.

access_paths.viewing_results: To look at a PNG yourself: mcp__remote-devices__device_stage_files (path under a connected folder) -> Read the staged path -> SendUserFile it to the user.
access_paths.matlab_tips: exportgraphics(gcf, '<abs path>.png', 'Resolution', 130). Plot scripts start with 'clear', so use absolute paths after run(), not variables set before it. readtable(..., 'VariableNamingRule','preserve') keeps CSV headers.

server.cadence_workdir: /home/linux/ieng6/ECE203_FA26_001/lix015  (holds cds.lib; start Virtuoso / run.sh from here)
server.course_module: module use /home/linux/ieng6/ECE203_FA26_001/public/modulefiles; module load ECE203_FA26_001  (interactive shortcut: type ECE203_FA26_001)
server.sim_dirs: ~/simulation/<cell>/spectre/schematic/...  (ADE L's own folder; OCEAN helpers use a suffix, e.g. schematic_family, so they never overwrite ADE L results)
server.pdk_models: /acsnfs3/software/IBM7RF/IBM_PDK/cmrf7sf/V2.0.0.2AM/Spectre/models  (design.scs, wafer.scs, allModels.scs section=tt). Files are IBM CONFIDENTIAL: copy only to the user's PC, never into this repo.

standard_loop: 1. Edit/add SKILL in this repo (cloud container), commit, push. If remote says the repo moved, set origin to https://github.com/TimmyXu015/AutoCircuit.git.
2. Start the job detached on ieng6 via MATLAB system('ssh ... nohup bash -lc ''~/AutoCircuit/run.sh <job>'' ...') from the cadence workdir.
5. Write a MATLAB plot script next to the data, run it, exportgraphics to PNG.
6. Stage + Read the PNG to check it, then SendUserFile. Tell the user how to read the quantity they need; leave the conclusion to them.

what_it_does: git pull first (so new jobs are found), then loads the course module if virtuoso is missing
non-GUI job: virtuoso -nograph with the batch file on stdin

GUI job (batch file contains '@gui', needed for ADE L): xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1600x1200x24' virtuoso -replay <file>; a watcher kills Virtuoso ~10 s after a CDS-log output line matching '^.o AC_BATCH_'
sets AC_BATCH=1 (acFinish then dbClose's cellviews instead of opening windows -> no stale locks)
prints status (AC_BATCH_DONE / AC_BATCH_FAILED), all 'AC>' lines, *Error* lines, and the M0 line of the fresh netlist
run_sh.batch_file_pattern:
;; comment
load(strcat(or(getShellEnvVar("AC_ROOT") strcat(getShellEnvVar("HOME") "/AutoCircuit")) "/ac.il"))
acBatch('fnName)
exit()        ; omit exit() in @gui jobs

jobs.p1a: HW1 P1a nfetx 5u/1u Ids vs VGS (+ ADE state p1a_auto in GUI)
jobs.hw1setup: @gui: builds HW1_203 cells p1_nmos, p1_pmos, p2_cs_amp and saves ADE L states hw1_p1_nmos, hw1_p1_pmos, hw1_p2_cs
jobs.hw1check: OCEAN sanity run of the three HW1 cells
jobs.p1c: NMOS Ids vs VGS family for VDS 0.1..1.8 -> ~/AutoCircuit_results/p1c_p1_nmos.csv
jobs.p1cp: PMOS |Id| vs VSG family for VSD 0.1..1.8 -> p1c_p1_pmos.csv
jobs.wsub: gm vs W at locked Ids (weak inversion study)
jobs.spsscan: self-practice sub vs strong CS amp: W scan at Id = 10 uA (VBIAS, gm, gm/Id, region, caps) -> sps_wscan.csv
jobs.sps: builds SelfPractice/cs_strong (W 0.75u) + cs_sub (W 400u), finds VBIAS for 10 uA, OP + AC 1..10G + tran 100 Hz/1 MHz -> sps_op.csv, sps_ac_<cell>.csv, sps_tran_<cell>_<f>.csv
jobs.spsade: @gui: ADE L states sps_100Hz / sps_1MHz (dc op + ac + tran, vars vbias/vamp/fin) in cs_strong and cs_sub
jobs.spsg: gate-driven sub vs strong CS amp: builds SelfPractice/cs_strong_gate (0.75u) + cs_sub_gate (400u) with RS = rs, CL = cl, V0 dc = vbias; OCEAN pass/fail check only
jobs.spsgade: @gui: ADE L states A_ideal/B_rs/C_rs_cl x 100Hz/1MHz in both gate-driven cells; outputs include OP("/M0" ...) gm/Id, bandwidth(VF("/vout") 3 "low"), GBW

skill_framework.entry: ac.il: acRoot from $AC_ROOT or ~/AutoCircuit; acFiles load order (pdk -> libs -> circuits); acJobs maps job symbol -> list of zero-arg step functions; acGo("job") in the CIW = pull + reload + run + report to ~/AutoCircuit_results/ciw_<job>.txt; acReload(); acBatch(fn) for run.sh.
add_a_job: write <name>.il with a zero-arg entry function and add it to acFiles in ac.il
add batch/<job>.il (pattern above); '@gui' in a comment if it needs ADE L / a display

libraries.pdk_cmrf7sf.il: acPdk: device lib cmrf7sf, model path, modelFiles ((design.scs "") (wafer.scs "") (allModels.scs "tt")), PDK desVars p5vonly/phires = 0, subNet sub!
libraries.lib_draw.il: acPinPt, acPlace (place instance so a named pin lands on a point), acWire (with label; filters freed wires), acGnd, acStub, acSetParam (runs CDF callback), acSetFirstParam, acSubTie (0 V source sub!->gnd), acOpenSch, acFinish (schCheck + markers report, save, close in batch), acDumpParams
libraries.lib_sim.il: acSimSetup(lib cell corner dirSuffix), acNum, acLog10, acResultsDir, acWavePoints (waveform -> list of (x y)), acZinAc
libraries.lib_ade.il: acAdeStart, acAdeModels, acAdeVars, acAdeAnalysis(sess type fields choices), acAdeChoice, acAdeOutput, acAdeSaveCurrents, acAdeSave, acAdeProbe (dumps the asi API of this install), acAutoOkStart (timer that answers modal dialogs)
libraries.acSay: printf + log file; uses lsprintf (never apply('sprintf ...))

skill_framework.hw1_helpers: hw1_setup.il: hw1Nmos/hw1Pmos configs, hw1Build, hw1Ade, hw1Check, hw1P1cFamily(?pmos t ?vdsList ... ?vAt 0.25 ?plots t) -- one ordinary DC run per VDS, curves copied to memory, CSV + plotted family in the GUI

ade_l_api_verified.vars: asiSetDesignVarList(sess list(list("vgs" "0") ...))  (include PDK vars p5vonly, phires)
ade_l_api_verified.analysis: ana = asiGetAnalysis(sess 'dc); set choice fields FIRST (sweep "Design Variable", rangeType start/stop, incrType linear, stepTypeLin step) via asiGetAnalysisFieldChoices + asiSetAnalysisFieldVal; then fields designVar AND param (netlister reads 'param, otherwise spectre: 'Missing sweep parameter'), start, stop, step, saveOppoint; asiEnableAnalysis(ana) LAST (takes the analysis object).
ade_l_api_verified.ac_analysis: fields start stop dec; choices sweep freq, rangeType start, incrType log, stepTypeLog decade
ade_l_api_verified.license_dialog: envSetVal("license" "ADEXL_UseNextLicense" 'string "always") before opening ADE, otherwise a modal 'Next License' dialog freezes headless runs; acAutoOkStart() as backup.
ade_l_api_verified.tran_analysis: field 'stop works. 'maxstep and 'step are in the field list but asiSetAnalysisFieldVal does not take them (ADE-5704 / reads back nil). Setting 'errpreset "conservative" froze a headless GUI job until the 600 s timeout -- do not set it.
ade_l_api_verified.outputs_op: sevAddExpression accepts OP("/M0" "gm") style expressions and bandwidth(VF("/vout") 3 "low"), VAR("fin") (added without error; evaluated by the user in ADE).

pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.devices: nfet/pfet (3-terminal, bulk on global sub!), nfetx/pfetx (4-terminal with B). CDF params w, l, nf (strings like "5u"). Netlists as inline subckt nfet/pfet -> BSIM3v3 (version 3.24) model nch/pch.
pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.substrate: Global net sub! must be tied (acSubTie: 0 V vdc sub!->gnd), and never label a net that is also gnd! (schCheck errors).
pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.cdf_callbacks: PDK callbacks (e.g. bicmos7wlfetWidthp) fail outside a form (concat error) -> ad/as/pd/ps may be stale; acSetParam sets cdfgData/cdfgForm and logs failures. Simulation results were still correct for W/L checks.
pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.pmos_bench: p1_pmos: source+bulk to gnd, drain at -vsd, gate at -vsg (orient MX) so sweep variable vsg and currents stay positive.
pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.model_file_structure: allModels.scs section X includes fixed_corner.scs section=X, process.scs, process_psp.scs, models.scs. Parameters like vth0 are expressions in process.scs: base constant + statistical term + fixed-corner adder (fixcnr*skewfix(...)) + wafer-specific term (k_wafer). In section tt fixcnr=0 and every adder evaluates to 0 (cor_*=0, k_wafer=0, mismatch mvth0=0), so the tt value is the base constant. Grep the model dir for <param>_n / <param>_p to find them.
pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.diffusion_params: CDF callbacks fail outside a form, so ad/as/pd/ps stay at the 0.43u-default values (ad=2.322e-13) whatever W is -> drain junction caps far too small for wide devices. Set them yourself: ad = as = W*0.54u, pd = ps = 2*(W+0.54u) (sps.il spsDiffParams; works with a design variable too: ad=wn*0.54e-6).
pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.op_readout: pv("M0" <param> ?result "dcOpInfo") works for the nfet subckt (gm, gds, id, vth, vdsat, region, cgg, cgs, cgd, cdd, cdb, cjd ...). region: 2 = saturation, 3 = subthreshold. Other dcOpInfo names under M0 are the PDK's parasitics: M0.cwgs/cwgd/cwds (wiring caps), M0.ddb/dsb (junction diodes), M0.rgate/rsext/rdext. Integers (region) need float() before %g formatting.

gotchas: sprintf via apply() re-evaluates args -> use lsprintf.
%g rejects integers in SKILL format strings -> pass floats (5.0 not 5).
't' is reserved in SKILL; do not use it as a variable.
Text replacements in ac.il once landed inside acLoadAll's header -> edit by exact blocks and re-read the file.
GUI schematic editing auto-merges wires and frees wire objects -> filter with dbValidP before labelling.
exit() inside a -replay file fires mid-job -> no exit() in @gui jobs; the run.sh watcher stops Virtuoso.
The watcher must match output lines ('^.o AC_BATCH_'), not the echoed source that contains the same text.
Killed batch Virtuoso leaves .cdslck lock files -> GUI opens the cell read-only. Batch now dbClose's; stale locks can be removed only when no Virtuoso owns them (ask before killing a user process).

OCEAN paramRun: the top-level result index referenced a log file only run 1 had, so the family read back as one curve -> loop ordinary run()s and copy each waveform to memory (acWavePoints) right after its run.
OCEAN results dir: use a suffix dir (acSimSetup ... "_family") so ADE L's own results are not overwritten.
cmd.exe on the PC: '%' and nested \" break commands (see access_paths.ssh.quoting_rules).
Over ssh, '*Error* eval: unbound variable - f' sometimes appears in run logs before the job; it has been harmless (status still OK).
Bridge: 60 s per call; device may disconnect -> detach long work with nohup and poll.

Starting a detached job (nohup ... &) over ssh from MATLAB system() sometimes still blocks the bridge until the job ends (> 60 s timeout). The job runs anyway: never re-launch after a timeout, check <job>_run.out first. 'ssh -n' + setsid + disown helped once but not always.
While a MATLAB system() call is still running, further evaluate_matlab_code calls return empty output (not an error) -- wait and retry.
Transferring a script to the PC: base64 it and write with fwrite(fid, matlab.net.base64decode('...')) in one evaluate call -- no quote escaping.
open_items: Axis labels on GUI family plots (hw1P1cFamily).
P2 AC setup inside an interactive ADE L run is untested (OCEAN check passed).
Consider making the repo private + deploy key, or keep it public and keep personal/PDK data out.
